steps.title: Buying a call
steps.say: The dashed line is zero. If the stock stays low, you lose only the 2 dollars you paid. Past the strike price, the line climbs. The tap marks break-even.
steps.alt: A zero line, then a hockey stick that climbs, with a tap at break-even.

steps.title: Buying a put
steps.say: A put is the mirror image. It gains value when the stock falls.

steps.title: Time works against you
steps.say: An option loses value as expiration gets closer, and it falls faster near the end. Most beginners lose money on options. This is paper money only.
steps.alt: A curve that falls faster toward the right.

quiz.q: You paid 2 dollars for a call. The stock crashed. What's the most you can lose?
quiz.why: When you buy an option, the most you can lose is what you paid.
